entities.name: Parthian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Parthian Empire, a political institution in Iran during Seleucid and Parthian Iran (247 BCE–224). Grew from Parthia and Rome fight repeatedly over Armenia and Mesopotamia and Battle of Carrhae — Parthians destroy Roman army under Crassus (53 BC). Led to the emergence of Arsacid.
